name: CommerceLint
description: Evidence-first product-page field screening and paid consistency diagnostics for ecommerce catalogs, policies, and implementation teams.

free_product.name: CommerceLint Product-Page Field Coverage Scanner
free_product.processing: Pasted HTML is analyzed locally in the visitor's browser.

agency_service.name: CommerceLint Agency Pilot
agency_service.description: White-label evidence and implementation backlogs for ecommerce agencies.

limitations: No guarantee of indexing, ranking, recommendation, purchase, traffic, or revenue.
URL retrieval is best effort; pasted HTML is the preferred scanner input.
Findings must be verified against the live storefront and current platform requirements.

developer_tool.name: CommerceLint CLI and GitHub Action
limitations: Field presence and discoverability screening only.
Does not prove selected-variant, feed, checkout, policy-text, rendered-JavaScript, or live-HTTP consistency.

paid_service.name: CommerceLint selected public-page diagnostics
paid_service.checkout_status: Unavailable. Public site accepts plan requests only. Stripe sandbox/live checkout is not connected; no card collection and no paid purchase claim until an observed sandbox receipt exists.

plans.name: Sample
plans.deliverable: Automated one-page field-check report with evidence and suggested repairs; no bespoke manual audit.

plans.name: Lite
plans.deliverable: A combined findings report with a prioritized repair list.

plans.name: Comprehensive
plans.deliverable: A consolidated backlog with recurring issues grouped and a retest checklist.

limitations: Selected public-page diagnostics only. No private accounts, store changes, feed audit, checkout testing, continuous monitoring, or guaranteed indexing, recommendation, traffic or sales. Interactive variants and linked policy pages are included only if explicitly agreed in scope.
